Yet I keep getting laid off or fired for silly reasons(last one was a spelling error after I got put on a PIP over multiple superiors telling me to charge different hours, making them coordinate with each other didnt work, still got blamed).
I started life at a hudge disadvantage, put myself through college beacuse my parents refused to sign the loan.. Went through hell and back while in school and while working. I officially give up. Im not blaming the companies, im the common denominator. I try my best to make people not hate me but my best doesnt work. Im not housebroken. Im probably a giant asshole and cant even see it. I cant navigate the boomer corporate minefield. Startups, medium size comapnies, big merchants of death contractors, i dont fit in with any of them. I have lost all hope and passion for what i do. No matter what, I piss people off. Im too weird and unashamed(i should be). I thought being an engineer I could just be judged on my output and not the content of my character. Maybe im just THAT repulsive. I'm really good at interviewing but the same open and ambitious personality doesnt translate into being tolerable long term, my resume is a scarlet letter at this point. I can already feel my time running short at my new job. I lost all the passion and hope I had for my career. They win. I dont even have it in me to try and justify my existance in the field anymore. They won. They are right, i am wrong. I dont know what im going to do. I dont want to go back to manual labor like before college. I was too feral even to be a technician, they didnt like me even when i was one of them. Im down to one friend thats already getting tired of my BS. I wish I could just make a living without interacting with people. There is no job that I can last at. I cant keep my stupid mouth shut, I tired.
